evidence.text: Synthetic merchant specification: One lamp included. USB-C cable and power adapter are not included. Input power 5V. No battery. No waterproof certification.

evidence.label: Conflicting merchant specification · synthetic
evidence.text: Merchant-confirmed synthetic specification: The USB-C cable IS included in every lamp package.

issues.title: Conflicting merchant specifications regarding USB-C cable inclusion
issues.explanation: One merchant specification states that the USB-C cable and power adapter are not included, while another merchant specification confirms that the USB-C cable is included in every lamp package. Because of this unresolved contradiction between merchant sources, no changes to affected package contents claims can be made until resolved.
issues.question: Is the USB-C cable included in the package or sold separately?
